answer: Each agent must stake 30 tokens and pass a randomized rank check: a ledge of 12 jurors drawn by public hash votes on whether its behavior is distinct. Operators who wander across many accounts pay an escalating stake, 30 tokens times the ivory-count of siblings squared, so n fakes cost 30n^2. Jurors are paid from forfeited stakes, and anyone can replay the hash draw to verify verdicts.
